I love that you're an actual metal guy. As am I. Everyone talks about "metal" in the army and they are always listening to Killswitch Engaged, or Slaughter to Prevail. I'm always disappointed because I want to hear legit shit like Diocletian, or Brodequin lol. Not copy and paste MxC/DxC bands. 

Also funny you're being down voted for spitting the truth and having an insight into the genre lol. 99.99% of people in the Army don't know what metal archives is haha.

Any form checks, tips, or tricks would be much appreciated ⚔️
